content: PostgreSQL official row security documentation provides per-row policies and default-deny behavior when RLS is enabled without a policy, but table owners and BYPASSRLS roles bypass by default and referential integrity checks can reveal information. Oblivious should use defense in depth: validated tenant identity at ingress, explicit organization scope in services and stores, optional RLS for high-risk tables, tenant fields in vectors and jobs, idempotency scoped by tenant, and positive plus cross-tenant denial tests at every boundary.
